entries.old_description: The Jekyll & Hyde piercing collection by Pralinesims features a whole set of sims 4 facial piercings. First, there are lip corner piercings then two versions of an anti-eyebrow piercing with a left & right version for each. These piercings come in 15 different colors and work for all genders and ages teen through elder. Where do I find piercings in Create-a-Sim (CAS)? Piercings are usually found under Accessories in CAS. Depending on the creator, they may appear in earrings, left/right rings, eyebrow, or even bracelet categories. Why aren’t my piercings showing up in-game?If your piercings aren’t showing up in CAS, it could be because you haven’t enabled ” Custom Content and Mods” in Game Options. After enabling it, restart your game for the CC to appear.
